editorial:
Imagine traveling to beautiful Rome to start a new life helping the church, only to find out that everyone around you is hiding a scary secret. You follow a young American woman who thinks she is doing a good thing, but she quickly realizes the church is actually planning something evil. The vibe is very creepy and makes you feel like something is always watching from the shadows. It builds up a lot of tension as you watch her try to figure out why she was really brought to Italy and who she can actually trust in a city full of lies.

The acting is great and the scary scenes really pop, though some parts move a bit slow. You will love the twists that keep you guessing until the very end. If you enjoy movies that make you feel uneasy, you should definitely check this one out.
endingExplained: You find out that the church wanted to create the Antichrist, so they used a secret plan to get the main character pregnant. In the final scenes, it is revealed that she is the mother of the beast. The movie ends by showing that the plan worked, setting up the birth of the famous demon child from the original films. It wraps up with the scary realization that evil has officially entered the world.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves creepy religious mysteries and jump scares.
